modelFields.coverageLabel: Source-linked 60-credit online baseline with retained UNIV 104, a 20-credit named major-elective allocation and 39 published outside credits.
rulesNotes: This 60-credit baseline retains UNIV 104 at three credits: 39 general-education credits + INDS 200 (1) + 20 general-elective credits.
The degree lists general electives in its major component. Their 21-credit major residency denominator includes INDS 200, and at least 25% remains at Liberty.
Every proposed elective is a distinct course not otherwise required by this degree. The printed recommendation to limit electives to two prefixes remains a recommendation.
RLGN 104, BIBL 104 and THEO 104 remain in this baseline; no transfer or assessment waiver is assumed.

unresolved.message: Submit original official records for Liberty’s individual transfer award, catalog eligibility, state-specific general-education additions and duplicate-learning evaluation.

Before university registration, document accepted prerequisite credit or required placement results and select available sections. No placement result, individual waiver or future section availability is assumed.

graduationRequirements.title: Graduation application
graduationRequirements.detail: Submit the degree completion application within the last semester of the anticipated graduation date.

graduationRequirements.title: Major course grades
graduationRequirements.detail: At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

obligations.title: UNIV 104 retained
obligations.notes: This baseline includes the published three-credit UNIV 104 course and the permitted 20-credit general-elective allocation. An individual zero-credit determination may change the elective allocation within its printed range.

gradePolicy.detail: At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

exclusions: The full-time rate requires at least 12 semester credits; eight-week subterms are not separate billing semesters.
Program-specific, military and other eligibility-based rates are outside this standard-rate model.
Technology, completion and course-specific fees remain separate.

publishedFees.label: Online technology fee
publishedFees.eligibility: Standard online fee; waived for actively serving military and their spouses under the published policy.

institutionMinCredits.calculation: 25% of this published degree total must be completed at Liberty.

externalMaxCredits.calculation: Published degree total less the 25% institutional minimum.
externalMaxCredits.scope: Overall outside-credit ceiling only. This does not establish a separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling or a particular provider award.

majorInstitutionFraction.scope: 25% of the exact major/minor component, unless the degree completion plan specifies otherwise. The denominator remains degree-specific.

majorResidencyBasisCredits.calculation: INDS 200 (1) plus the printed 20-credit lower end of the 20–23-credit general-elective component; the retained 3-credit UNIV 104 leaves 21 major credits.

policyReview.message: The reviewed online undergraduate catalog publishes no separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling. Its documented overall transfer and degree/major residency rules remain enforced. Each outside course still requires its own published receiving award and provider eligibility; no numeric alternative-credit allowance or student award is inferred.
